summary.zh: 判断是否真找到 PMF 并分配投入
summary.en: Product leadership for PMF, vision and portfolio investment

description.zh: 面向产品负责人，处理 PMF 的衡量、产品愿景、多条产品线的投入分配和产品团队设计。也可用于准备董事会的产品汇报。适合不确定是否真的找到 PMF，或要在几个产品之间分资源的时候。
description.en: Product leadership support: measuring product-market fit, shaping a vision, splitting investment across products and designing the product org. Also helps prepare board product updates. For when PMF is in doubt.
